description: Check that detail rows add up to the totals a summary declares, group by group. Sums are computed exactly on the decimal text, never through floating point: a float sum of 0.10 and 0.20 is 0.30000000000000004, so a tool built on one reports a false mismatch on the group that actually balances. Reports mismatches with the exact difference, groups with detail and no declared total, and totals with no detail at all. Pay 180000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

delimiter.description: Single field separator. Defaults to a comma.

detail.description: The detail rows. Delimited text with a header row, at most 262144 bytes and 5000 data rows. RFC 4180 quoting is honoured. Nothing is fetched.

detail_amount.description: The column in the detail to sum.

group_by.description: The columns identifying a group in both datasets. A composite key is supported. Values are canonicalised exactly, so 42 and 42.0 are the same key and a large identifier is compared as text rather than collapsed.

summary.description: The declared totals, one row per group. Delimited text with a header row, at most 262144 bytes and 5000 data rows. RFC 4180 quoting is honoured. Nothing is fetched.

summary_amount.description: The column in the summary holding the declared total.

tolerance.description: Absolute difference that is acceptable, as a number or a decimal string. Defaults to exact equality.

name: aggregate_reconciliation

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of the data was not, which is a different problem from data that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

row.description: 1-based and counting the header, so it matches a text editor.

difference.description: Exact decimal text, so a cent of drift is never rounded away.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

reconciled.description: True only when both sides were fully read, every group matched within tolerance, and nothing was left uncompared.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: Aggregate Reconciliation
